free_text: The 61-year-old male has prostate adenocarcinoma with a Gleason score of 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1) and a cT1c stage, evidenced by a PI-RADS 5 lesion on MRI. His PSA is elevated at 5.9 ng/mL, and he has moderate LUTS. Management requires clinical review to balance treatment benefit against patient preferences for surveillance, given the established cancer and imaging findings.
